en_title: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth Director David Fincher Sparks Backlash for 'Wildly Dystopian' Vision of AI-powered Filmmaking
cn_title: 《The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth》导演大卫·芬奇因其「极度反乌托邦」的人工智能电影制作愿景引发强烈反弹
opus_summary: 大卫·芬奇确认在《影后风云》中使用AI替换对白并调整演员口型，以减少拍摄次数。他还畅想未来先拍摄主镜头，再借助AI生成其他镜头，这番言论引发批评，有人称其设想「极度反乌托邦」，也有人为其辩护。

paragraphs.en: Director David Fincher has sparked a backlash after setting out what some have called a “dystopian” vision for AI-fueled filmmaking, amid controversy over AI use in Netflix movie The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth .
paragraphs.cn: Netflix电影《The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth》使用人工智能一事正引发争议之际，导演大卫·芬奇阐述了自己对人工智能驱动电影制作的愿景，一些人称其为「反乌托邦」，并因此引发强烈反弹。

paragraphs.en: Fincher, who directed Seven, Fight Club, and The Curious Case of Benjamin Button, has reunited with long-term collaborator Brad Pitt for The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth, which was written by Quentin Tarantino. It is a standalone sequel and spinoff to Tarantino’s Once Upon a Time in Hollywood, with Pitt reprising his role as stunt double Cliff Booth.
paragraphs.cn: 曾执导《七宗罪》《搏击俱乐部》和《本杰明·巴顿奇事》的芬奇，在《The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth》中再次与长期合作伙伴布拉德·皮特携手，该片由昆汀·塔伦蒂诺编剧。影片是塔伦蒂诺执导的《好莱坞往事》的独立续集及衍生作品，皮特再次饰演替身演员Cliff Booth。

paragraphs.en: In a recent interview with Sean Fennessey on The Ringer’s Big Picture podcast , Fincher confirmed that he used AI to sync the best take of a line reading with the best performance take when they didn’t align on camera, in order to speed up production by cutting down the number of takes needed. Essentially, he used AI to replace dialogue and adjust actors’ lip movements in post-production.
paragraphs.cn: 在The Ringer的《Big Picture》播客最近一期由Sean Fennessey主持的采访中，芬奇证实，当镜头前台词念得最好的一次与表演最好的一次并不一致时，他会使用人工智能将两者同步，以减少所需拍摄次数，加快制作进度。简单来说，他在后期制作中使用人工智能替换对白并调整演员的唇部动作。

paragraphs.en: “We could use AI to re-lip that thing,” he said. “So it was freeing, it was the freeing up of… think of this entirely plastically. We’re not chiseling this out of marble. We’re working with plasticine. You know what I mean? Just giving ourselves that freedom to go, ‘what is the best thing on the eye, and then what is the best thing on the ear,’ and f***ing do not worry about how we’re going to get there, because we will figure out a way. And we did, in most cases. I think there’s a couple of shots [that] didn’t quite work, but they’re getting there. By the time it’s on service.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我们可以用人工智能重新调整那个画面的口型，」他说。「所以这让人得到了解放，解放了……完全把它当成可塑的东西来考虑。我们不是在大理石上雕刻，而是在用橡皮泥创作。你明白我的意思吗？就是给自己这样的自由，去想，‘什么画面看起来最好，然后什么声音听起来最好’，他妈的不用担心我们要怎么做到，因为我们会想出办法。而且大多数情况下我们确实做到了。我想有几个镜头效果不太理想，但正在接近目标。等到它上线的时候。」

paragraphs.en: Fincher added that the actors spent just a handful of days re-recording dialogue. Dialogue replacement was just 5% conventionally done, the rest “all AI.”
paragraphs.cn: 芬奇补充说，演员们只花了几天时间重新录制对白。对白替换只有5%采用了传统方式，其余「全靠人工智能」。

paragraphs.en: But it was his comments made later in the interview, where Fincher described how he sees directing with AI going in the future, that have sparked the most vociferous response.
paragraphs.cn: 但引发最强烈反应的是芬奇在采访后段发表的言论，他在其中描述了自己眼中未来使用人工智能执导电影的方式。

paragraphs.en: Here’s the relevant section in full:
paragraphs.cn: 以下是相关内容的全文：

paragraphs.en: “I’m imagining — and what I’ve seen with AI technology — I’m imagining a world in the next year where everything that humans do great, like sculpting, painting, ageing, blowing fake spider’s webs into the corner, smoking up a volume, putting a shaft of light in it, putting a crazy f***ing wig on somebody, doing all their makeup… like, I can imagine a world where — and I don’t think we’re far away — you hire all the same people. And you walk into a set that’s beautifully handcrafted, and you hire all those people, and you shoot the master. You shoot the master 20, 25 times till you get it worked out exactly. And you’re doing surface capture at the exact same time that you’re filming. And then you go in and you sit all the actors in chairs wherever they land, and they perform from the clavicles up, same scene, but you move the crew. The crew’s now moving to the next stage, they’re pre-lighting that, they’re getting that ready.
paragraphs.cn: 「我想象着——根据我所见过的人工智能技术——我想象着未来一年里的一个世界，人类擅长的一切，比如雕塑、绘画、做旧、把假蜘蛛网吹到角落里、在一个空间里打烟、让一束光照进来、给某人戴上一顶他妈的疯狂假发、给他们化好全套妆……我能想象这样一个世界——而且我认为我们离它不远了——你还是雇用同样的所有人。你走进一个精美手工打造的布景，雇用所有那些人，然后拍摄主镜头。主镜头拍20次、25次，直到完全达到你的要求。而你在拍摄的同时进行表面捕捉。然后你进去，让所有演员无论到了哪里都坐在椅子上，只表演锁骨以上的部分，还是同一场戏，但工作人员转场了。工作人员这时正前往下一个摄影棚，提前布光，做好准备。

paragraphs.en: “So essentially, the filmmaking process is about just shooting the masters. And all of the iteration, the over-shoulders, the close-ups, all that stuff is derived from the material that you do sitting in a chair after everyone leaves.
paragraphs.cn: 「所以从根本上说，电影制作过程就是拍摄主镜头。而所有的反复调整、过肩镜头、特写镜头，所有那些东西，都来自其他人离开后你坐在椅子上完成的素材。

paragraphs.en: “And then, the part that seems to provoke such a violent, vitriolic response in people — ‘Oh my God, he made me do it 20 times!’ — it’s like, now I don’t need to do that, because I won’t miss focus in AI. And I will land a stick the dolly shot in AI. And I will be able to make sure that that hair doesn’t cross right in front of your cornea in AI.
paragraphs.cn: 「然后，那个似乎会在人们那里引发如此激烈、尖刻反应的部分——‘天哪，他让我拍了20次！’——现在我不需要那么做了，因为用人工智能我不会失焦。我也能用人工智能把固定机位和移动机位镜头拍好。我还能用人工智能确保那根头发不会正好挡在你的角膜前面。

paragraphs.en: “And it’ll still be based on real human beings, and it’ll still be based on real human — the way humans move and how they traverse a set and however they pull up their trousers before they sit down or take their coat off — all that stuff will be there, but people will only have to do it 15 times.”
paragraphs.cn: 「而且它仍然会以真实的人为基础，仍然会以真实的人类——人们移动的方式、他们如何穿过布景、他们坐下或脱掉外套之前如何提起裤子——所有这些都会在，但人们只需要做15次。」

paragraphs.en: In the interview, Fennessey then asked: “Does working that way appeal to you?”
paragraphs.cn: 采访中，Fennessey接着问道：「那样的工作方式对你有吸引力吗？」

paragraphs.en: Fincher’s comments were roundly criticized on social media, where people hit out at not just the heavy use of AI in The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth, but the prospect of seeing a performance from the likes of Brad Pitt that isn’t real.
paragraphs.cn: 芬奇的言论在社交媒体上遭到广泛批评，人们抨击的不仅是《The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth》大量使用人工智能，还有未来可能看到布拉德·皮特这类演员并非真实做出的表演。

paragraphs.en: “David Lynch: The camera accidentally caught a crew member in the mirror so I incorporated him into the story and ended up with one of the most memorable characters in TV and movie history,” writer and critic David Hering said in a post on social media . “David Fincher: I spent $400m to change the shape of Brad Pitt’s mouth when he says ‘hello.’”
paragraphs.cn: 「大卫·林奇：摄影机不小心拍到了镜子里的一个工作人员，于是我把他写进了故事，最终创造出影视史上最令人难忘的角色之一，」作家兼评论家David Hering在社交媒体的一则帖子中写道。「大卫·芬奇：我花了4亿美元来改变布拉德·皮特说‘你好’时的嘴形。」

paragraphs.en: “Any movie that uses even a sliver of AI should be immediately disqualified from awards consideration,” said another person . “Disgusting.”
paragraphs.cn: 「任何哪怕只使用了一丁点人工智能的电影，都应该立即被取消评奖资格，」另一个人说。「恶心。」

paragraphs.en: “Saying, ‘I wanna take an actor’s eye movement from Take 1 with an actors lip movement from Take 3’…that’s not the performance the actor gave on set! You don’t get to create the perfect performance by Frankenstein-ing a ‘perfect version’ of the performance and call it directing,” actor Mike Kalinowski commented .
paragraphs.cn: 「说什么‘我想把演员第一次拍摄时的眼部动作和第三次拍摄时的唇部动作放在一起’……那不是演员在片场给出的表演！你不能像弗兰肯斯坦造人一样拼出一个表演的‘完美版本’，创造出完美表演，然后把它叫作导演工作，」演员Mike Kalinowski评论道。

paragraphs.en: “I’m not saying Fincher is not an incredible director. But he’s also known for doing an ungodly amount of takes to get exactly what he wants. But you’re when you’re working with actors, it’s never gonna be perfect. That’s what makes it art.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我不是说芬奇不是一位出色的导演。但他也因拍摄次数多得惊人、只为得到他想要的确切效果而出名。但当你和演员合作时，永远不可能十全十美。这才让它成为艺术。」

paragraphs.en: One person called Fincher’s proposed production process “wildly dystopian,” another “depressing as f**k.” Another quipped: “there is no longer a need for David Fincher.” "Imagine doing 135 takes just to be asked back for an ADR session where the Ben Grokfleck Machine updates your lips," another said .
paragraphs.cn: 有人称芬奇提出的制作流程「极度反乌托邦」，另一个人称其「他妈的令人沮丧」。还有人打趣道：「已经不再需要大卫·芬奇了。」「想象一下，拍了135次，结果还要被叫回去参加一场对白补录，让Ben Grokfleck Machine更新你的嘴唇。」另一个人说。

paragraphs.en: “Fincher's vision of a largely A.I. production is undeniably bleak but I suspect people would be less perplexed if it was more widely understood (as a friend remarked to me recently) that Fincher's filmmaking process was always more about control than perfection,” writer Brendan Hodges said .
paragraphs.cn: 「芬奇关于主要依靠人工智能制作影片的愿景无疑是黯淡的，但我猜，如果更多人明白芬奇的电影制作过程一向更注重控制而非完美（正如一位朋友最近对我说的），人们可能就不会那么困惑了。」作家Brendan Hodges说。

paragraphs.en: However, there are some that are defending Fincher here, saying his AI vision isn’t a million miles away from the editing process that goes on without AI, where different parts of takes are edited together to create the best scene. The counter to that response is of course that there’s a difference between editing together actual performance from different takes, and using AI to create a performance that was never given.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，也有一些人在这件事上为芬奇辩护，称他的人工智能愿景与不使用人工智能的剪辑过程并没有天壤之别：后者会将不同拍摄版本的片段剪辑在一起，以创造出最佳场景。当然，对这种说法的反驳是，将不同拍摄版本中真实的表演剪辑在一起，与使用人工智能创造从未有过的表演，两者是有区别的。

paragraphs.en: AI is one of, if not the hottest topics in the entertainment industry, and Hollywood is currently wrestling with maintaining its humanity in the creative process while cutting down costs and raising productivity. Hollywood, like the video game industry, is beset with layoffs as cost-cutting and AI disruption hit hard.
paragraphs.cn: 人工智能即使不是娱乐行业最热门的话题，也是最热门的话题之一。好莱坞目前正努力在削减成本、提高生产效率的同时，维持创作过程中的人性。与电子游戏行业一样，好莱坞在成本削减和人工智能带来的冲击下遭遇大量裁员。

paragraphs.en: Earlier this month, Star Wars writer Tony Gilroy sounded the alarm over the rising tide of AI slop that he said was a threat to human-made movies. Speaking to Vanity Fair , Gilroy implored movie fans to vote against the spread of AI data centers — and even jokingly suggested that the artificial intelligence-fuelling tech hubs should be blown up.
paragraphs.cn: 本月早些时候，《星球大战》编剧托尼·吉尔罗伊对人工智能粗制滥造内容的日益泛滥发出警告，他称这对人类制作的电影构成了威胁。吉尔罗伊在接受Vanity Fair采访时恳请影迷投票反对人工智能数据中心的扩张，甚至开玩笑地提议炸毁这些为人工智能提供动力的技术中心。

paragraphs.en: In September, acclaimed filmmaker Guillermo Del Toro spoke out against AI , saying the “alchemy” of creativity and discovery humans experience when crafting a story or artwork is unachievable by a machine, and that many of the best works are often elevated by "accidents" that happen during the creative process.
paragraphs.cn: 9月，备受赞誉的电影人吉尔莫·德尔·托罗公开反对人工智能，称人类在创作故事或艺术作品时经历的创造力与发现的「炼金术」是机器无法实现的，而许多最优秀的作品往往因创作过程中发生的「意外」而得到提升。

paragraphs.en: And in July, The Odyssey director Christopher Nolan praised the "immediate and harsh" judgment of "AI slop" from younger audiences .
paragraphs.cn: 而在7月，《奥德赛》导演克里斯托弗·诺兰称赞年轻观众对「人工智能粗制滥造内容」作出的「即时而严厉」的评判。

paragraphs.en: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth opened in IMAX theaters on November 25, and hits Netflix on December 23.
paragraphs.cn: 《The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth》于11月25日在IMAX影院上映，并将于12月23日登陆Netflix。
